spans.s:
m. (-ञ्चः)
A mountain: see क्रौञ्च.

f. (-दा)
A species of metre of four lines, and twenty-five syllables in each.

m. (-णः)
A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
क्रोञ्च or क्रौञ्च a mountain, and दारण the render or tearer; also क्रौञ्चदारण.

nf. (-डं-डा)
1 The breast, the chest.
2 The haunch, the flank, the hollow above the hip.
m. (-डः)
1 A name of Śani or

Saturn.
2

A hog.
E.
क्रुड to be thick, घञ् aff.

f. (-र्णी)
A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारिका.

m. (-दः)
A turtle, a tortoise.
E.
क्रोड the breast, and पाद a foot.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A tortoise.

m. (-ङ्गिः)
A turtle or tortoise.
E.
क्रोड and अङ्गि a foot.

n. (-णं)
Embracing.
E.
क्रोड breast or side, करण making, and च्चि augment.

f. (-तिः)
Embracing, mutual embrace.
E.
see the preceding; कृति making.

m. (-थः)
Killing, slaying.
E.
क्रुथ to kill or hurt, affix घञ्.

m. (-धः)
Anger, wrath.
E.
क्रुध to be angry, affix घञ्.

mf. (-जः-जा-जं)
Proceeding from or engendered by wrath; it especially applies to eight vices, hatred, envy, oppression, violence, &c.
E.
क्रोध passion, and ज produced.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Passionate, angry, wrathful.
f. (-ना)
A passionate woman, a vixen.
E.
क्रुध to be angry, affix युच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Provocative.
n. (-यं)
An injury.
E.
क्नुध to be angry, (on account of,) अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Angry, passionate.
E.
क्रोध, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Passionate, angry, overcome with rage.
m. (-तः)
A kind of perfume, commonly Cor.
E.
क्रोध wrath, and मूर्च्छित confused, overcome.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Free from wrath, mild, calm.
E.
क्रोध, and वर्जित devoid of.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Passionate, violent.
E.
क्रोध, and वश subject to.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
Angry, passionate.
E.
क्रोध angry, affix इनि.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Calm, composed, free from wrath.
E.
क्रोध, and उज्झित abandoned.

m. (-शः)
A measure of distance, a league, a Koś, containing 4000 cubits; some double this, and make the Koś 8000 cubits.
E.
क्रुश to call, &c. affix घञ्.

mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्)
Crying, calling out. क्रुश to cry, शत् aff.

m. (-लः)
A large or double drum.
E.
क्रोश a Koś, and ताल a tune; whose sound may be heard for a league.

m. (-निः)
A large drum.
E.
क्रोश, and ध्वनि sound: see the preceding.

n. (-गं)
A measure of two Koś 4000 yards, or about 2½ miles; this seems to correspond to the modern Koś, but the standard varies.
E.
क्रोश a Koś, and युग a pair; also गव्यूति.

mf. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री)
A jackall.
E.
क्रुश to cry or call, and तुन् affix; the noun declined in many cases like nouns in ऋ.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly Chaculiya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) or according to some, Ramvāsac, a different plant: see क्रोष्टुविन्ना.
E.
क्रोष्टु a jackall, कन् affix, and पुच्छिका tail; the flower being compared to the tail of the animal.

f. (-ला)
The plant Cāculiya; see the preceding.

f. (-का)
See क्रोष्टुकपुच्छिका: also क्रोष्टुपुच्छी.

f. (-न्ना)
The name of a plant, either Chaculiya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) or a different plant called Ramvāsac.
E.
क्रोष्टु a jackall, and विन्न known; known by being compared to the animal.

m. (-क्षुः)
The white sugar cane.
E.
क्रोष्ट, and इक्षु cane.

f. (-ष्ट्री)
1 The black or white Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus): see भूमिकुष्माण्डक.
2 Cāculiya: see क्रोष्टुविन्ना.
3 A she jackall: see क्रोष्टु.
E.
क्रुश to cry, affix ष्ट्रन् and fem. ङीप्.
